name: Blood Blade
body:
School transmutation; Level sorcerer/wizard 5

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S

EFFECT

Range touch
Target one bladed weapon touched
Duration 1 min./level
Saving Throw Will negates (harmless, object); Spell Resistance yes (harmless, object)

DESCRIPTION

By touching a bladed weapon (such as a spear, sword, dagger, or the like), you imbue it with the wounding special quality for the duration of this spell. For more information, see the wounding special quality. You cannot cast this spell on a weapon that already has the wounding special quality.
